environment: Local production build, synthetic review account and Matrix room
observation: Chrome CDP request counts after initial loading, with no conversation changes
implementation: One bounded native room sync observes typing and message, redaction and membership changes
Event fields are restricted to identifiers, type and the typing user set; returned data is validated
Room and thread history no longer have a periodic refetch timer
Changes and limited/reset signals revalidate loaded active history through TanStack sequential cursor recovery
A change received during pagination is replayed without acknowledging its cursor until history can be reconciled
Background, offline and disposal cancel the observer; authorization errors also revalidate cached history
limitations: A single local idle observation, not a throughput benchmark or million-user qualification
Changed history still refetches loaded pages; incremental content patches and large-burst anchor retention remain open
Browser viewport testing does not qualify physical iOS or Android devices
functionalVerification: A synthetic message sent through a second browser tab appeared in the receiving desktop tab without reload
A synthetic reply sent through the second tab appeared in an already open receiving mobile thread without reload
The mobile bottom navigation remained visible during thread reading
